set.statement: In a review run `rhiza run findings` and `rhiza run verdict` take the check they belong to, and each review finding has a severity (blocker, major, minor, nit), the leaf it is about when there is one, a place (file:line or node) and a reason, while plan review findings keep their seven kinds (missing-acceptance, missing-provenance, unreal-depends-on, outside-intent, contradiction, uncovered-intent, oversized-leaf); `rhiza run status` shows each check's rounds with findings and verdicts.
